text: The photo shows a benchtop rocker/shaker on a white surface against a pale wall. At right is a white rectangular control unit with a dark grey top panel, a round grey knob, and printed labels. Extending to the left is a black platform/rack with two rows of circular holes (roughly ten visible openings, most empty), mounted on a black L-shaped bracket with a green-and-white label at its base. In the leftmost hole stands an upright clear vial capped with an orange-red screw cap; it holds a whitish, cloudy liquid partway up. A white card with a black square fiducial marker and the number "621" lies flat on the platform between the holes. Dark strips lie on the surface in the foreground.
